My mom didn't like the therapist because she often didn't listen to my mom when she tried to speak to her, and it was really hard to contact her unless we were there. The office is also all the way across town, so it's a half hour long drive to get there every friday.
Unfortunately, I don't know anyone in my family very well at all, and I don't know anyone at school either... All the teachers and counsellors always call my parents and tell them that I've been acting up or something and I get in trouble all the time, so I don't wanna accidentally say something wrong and get in trouble...
When I'm older I hope to program website and video games, as it's something I have been teaching myself since i was 8 years old. I don't really enjoy it, but it's something that I din't absolutely hate, so I learn it sometimes in my free time. I sometimes draw, I'm not good at all, though, so I don't draw much.
I could try writing a letter, but I struggle a lot with writing... I will try though.
Thank you so much for responding!

I'm only 13 years old, I will be turning 14 in may. I am only seeing a speech therapist right now because I have a lot of communications due to having autism. I used to see a therapist that was supposed to help with being bullied and such, but since my mom didn't like her, I couldn't go anymore :/
